export PATH=/ccc/scratch/cont002/cerfacs/drozdalu/software/julia-1.13.0/bin:$PATH
export JULIA_DEPOT_PATH=/ccc/scratch/cont002/cerfacs/drozdalu/.julia
julia -e '
using CUDA
import JACC
println("node: ", gethostname())
ndev = length(CUDA.devices())
println("visible_devices: ", ndev)
ok = ndev >= 2
for dev in 0:min(1, ndev-1)
    CUDA.device!(dev)
    a = JACC.zeros(Float32, 1024)
    JACC.parallel_for(1024, (i, x) -> x[i] = Float32(i), a)
    correct = (a isa CuArray) && (Array(a) == Float32.(1:1024))
    println("device ", dev, " jacc_correct: ", correct)
    global ok = ok && correct
end
if ok
    println("PASS: dual_gpu_single_node")
else
    println("FAIL: dual_gpu_single_node")
end
'
